Caliber 0.308, 177gr, HPBT. One of the most common match bullets in the country, so expect the widest retailer coverage of anything in the seed set.

Caliber 0.264 (6.5mm), 140gr VLD. Berger part numbers are the maker's own and are carried by most specialist retailers.

The archetypal medium rifle powder and probably the single most searched-for item in reloading. No manufacturer part number: powders are sold by brand and name, not SKU, so the search term IS the key. match_quality is 'model' rather than 'exact_sku' for exactly that reason.
